s: Sheyyakol lekabbot hanner bishbil hacholeh ubo d' seipim: muttar lekabbot et hanner bishbil hacholeh sheyyishan, im hu choleh sheyyesh bo chashash sakkana im lo yishan. Veken mi shemmityare mippene listim shello yaharguhu — muttar lekabbot hanner shello yiruhu, sheppiqquach nepesh docheh shabbat apillu bachashash sepeq sakkana, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shk"ch. Abal im en sham chashash sakkanat nepashot ella sakkanat mamon, veken bishbil choleh sheen bo sakkana — asur lekabbot middibre soperim, veim kibba — patur, mippene sheen issur min hattora ella bimlaka hatztzerika legupah, kelomar shehammelaka tzerika lo bishbil gupah, dehaynu shetztzarik lo gup haddabar sheggup hammelaka naaset bo, kegon shemmekabbeh etzim doleqim bishbil happechamim, shehem reuyim letzorepim, sheggup meleket hakkibbuy naaseh begup happechamim shehem tzerikim lo, abal melaka sheenah tzerika legupah hi keshehi tzerika lo bishbil dabar acher sheen gup hammelaka naaset bo, kegon shemmekabbeh et hanner mippene shechas al hashshemen shello yidlaq kullo akshav, o mippene shechas al cheres hanner shello yibbaqa keshehappetila doleqet alayv, sheggup meleket hakkibbuy naaseh bappetila, vehu mitkavven bimlakto mippene shetztzarik lashshemen o lanner, veken hamkabbeh et haddeleqa mippene shechas al mamono, veken hamkabbeh gachelet bishbil shello yizzoqu bah rabbim, veken zeh shemmekabbeh bishbil hacholeh o mippene hallistim — hare zeh melaka sheenah tzerika legupah, kevan sheeno mitkavven bishbil tzorek happechamim o happetila shehakkibbuy naaseh bahen. Vaapillu im mekabbeh bishbil shetztzarik lappetila — eno chayyab ella im ken tzarik lachazor ulehadliqah achar zeman, vegam hi petila chadasha, shezzehu paam rishon shehudleqa, vegam lo hubhaba qodem shehudleqa, sheal yede kibbuy zeh hi mittaqqenet lehadlaqa yoter mimmah shehayeta battechilla. Abal im en tzarik lachazor ulehadliqah leachar zeman, vaapillu im tzarik lachazor ulehadliqah ella shehi petila yeshana shekkebar hudleqa paam achat, vaapillu hi petila chadasha shello hudleqa miqqodem kelal ella shehubhaba qodem shehudleqa, sheal yede kibbuy zeh enah mittaqqenet lehadlaqa yoter mimmah shehayeta battechilla — hare zeh melaka sheenah tzerika legupah, sheap shehu tzarik legup haddabar shehammelaka naaset bo, dehaynu shehappecham shebberoshah shehakkibbuy naaseh bo hu tzarik lo sheyyehe noach lachazor ulehadliqah, mikkol maqom kevan shehaddabar shehammelaka naasa bo eno mitettaqqen kelum al yede hammelaka yoter mimmah shehaya battechilla — hare en hammelaka tzerika legupah shel oto dabar kelal, kevan sheen metaqqenet oto kelum, veenah niqret melaka hatztzerika legupah ella im ken shehammelaka metaqqenet et gup haddabar shennaaset bo yoter mimmah shehaya battechilla, sheaz hi tzerika legupah, vegam sheyyehe tzorek laadam begup haddabar shehammelaka naaset bo umetaqqenet oto:

Bameh debarim amurim? Bekibbuy, shehi meleket qilqul, shemmeqalqel hahabara, lepikak enah chashuba tzerika legupah bezeh bilbad mah sheggup haddabar shennaaset bo tzarik lehaadam, ella ad sheggup haddabar mitettaqqen al yede hammelaka shennaaset bo yoter mimmah shehaya battechilla. Veken hassoter binyan al menat lachazor velibnoto, o haqqorea al menat lachazor velitpor — en asur min hattora ella im ken im dato sheyyehe binyan haacharon yoter tob min harishon, veken bitpirat habbeged, shennimtzeu hassetira vehaqqeria hen metaqqenim habbinyan vehabbeged sheyyihyu yoter tob mibbattechilla, shemmibbilade hassetira vehaqqeria i epshar kelal letaqqen habbinyan vehabbeged sheyyihyu yoter tobim. Abal shear melakot sheenan melakot haqqilqul, ap [im] enan metaqqenot et gup haddabar shennaaset bo, shekkevan sheggup haddabar shennaaset bo hu tzarik lehaadam — hare zeh hammelaka hatztzerika legupah, kegon hammotzi qardom mereshut lirshut kede lachtok bo, sheap sheen haqqardom mitettaqqen kelal behotzaa zo — hare zeh chayyab, hoil vehu tzarik legup haddabar shehotzi. Abal im eno tzarik legup haddabar shehotzi, kegon hammotzi met liqbura, sheggup hammet en lo bo shum tzorek kelal — hare zeh melaka sheenah tzerika legupah, veken kol kayyotze bezeh. Veyesh omerim sheapillu meleket haqqilqul en tzarik sheyyihyeh hattiqqun yoter tob mibbattechilla. Chutz mimmekabbeh hanner, sheeno chayyab ella im ken nitkavven lehabheb happetila al yede kibbuy zeh shettehe nocha lachazor ulehadliqah. Abal im eno choshesh al hibhubah, ella shemmitkavven bekibbuyo lachus aleha shello tidlaq kullo akshav, ap al pi shemmitkavven kede lachazor ulehadliqah leachar zeman, mikkol maqom iqqar gup haddabar shemmeleket hakkibbuy naaseh bo hu happecham shebberoshah shehaur achaz bo, vekevan sheen kavvanato bekibbuyo bishbil shetztzarik lepecham zeh ella bishbil shetztzarik lishar happetila shello achaz bah haur — hare zeh melaka sheenah tzerika legupa ella ledabar acher sheen hammelaka naaset bo:

Vekol zeh lehaomerim shemmelaka sheenah tzerika legupah patur aleha veenah asura ella middibre soperim. Abal yesh choleqin al zeh veomerim sheapillu melaka sheen tzerika legupah chayyab aleha min hattora. Umikkol maqom, ap lepi dibrehem muttar lekabbot hanner bishbil sheyyishan hacholeh sheyyesh bo sakkana. Veken mi shemmityare mippene hallistim, veyesh chashash (sakkana bedabar) sakkanot nepashot. Abal im en sham ella chashash tzaar haggup bilbad beinyan shei epshar labo leolam lide chashash sakkana mitztzaar hahu — asur lekabbot. Veim kibba — chayyab lepi dibrehem. Vehachilluqim shebben b' hassebarot ellu lahalaka ulemaaseh yitbaaru kol echad veechad al meqomo. Veyesh debarim harbeh shehakkol modim sheen bahem issur min hattora ella im ken tzarik legupan. Veyesh debarim shehakkol modim bahem shechayyab alehem min hattora ap al pi sheen tzarik legupan. Veyitbaer gam ken kol echad veechad bimqomo:

Vehakkol modim bi"pesiq resheh velo yamut" shechayyab alayv min hattora lipamim. Veketzad matzinu zeh? Vahalo kesheeno mitkavven limlaka — bevadday en tzarik legupah kelal. Matzinu bikgon shehaddabar yadua shennoach lo bimlaka shennaaset belo kavvanato vechapetz hu bah ap al pi shello nitkavven lah, vahare hi tzerika lo akshav shekkebar naaset meeleha belo kavvanato. Ketzad? Kegon neqeb shebbechabit shemmotziin bo hayyayin sheppaquq binoret shel pishtan, shehanneoret belua miyyayin harbeh, ukeshemmotziah vechozer upoqeq bah umehaddeqah bechozeq — i epshar shello yischot yayin mimmenna, veap al pi sheeno mitkavven ella listom hanneqeb — hare zeh "pesiq resheh", veim yesh keli tachat peqiqat hanneoret shehayyayin hannischat mimmenna notep letoko — hare zeh chayyab al peqiqa zo, shehaddabar yadua shennoach lo bayyayin hannischat mehanneoret letok hakkeli sheyyukal lehanot mimmennu kesheyyihyeh bakkeli, abal kesheyyihyeh balua binoret — en lo bah hanaa shel kelum, vahare zo melaka hatztzerika legupah ap al pi shello nitkavven lah.
